answer: The vertex test I would run is Physiotherapist licence with health board attestation: a licence number in the health board register, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a licence number in the health board register stays private; the willow is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the basalt of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
